rows.grounds: niṣka = a gold coin or unit of weight/value; morphology nominal stem
mātra = measure, extent, or mere amount; morphology nominal form
pradāna = giving, offering; instrumental sense expressed as means without grammatical label
sva + ācārya compound = one's own teacher or preceptor
caraṇa = foot; first member of compound with following token
uncertain; possibly related to ambuja/ambu-ja (lotus) in compound with caraṇa (caraṇāmbuja = lotus-feet), form nonstandard or sandhi-affected
